# LRIT Header Description

As described in [File Header Processing](/pt/goes-satellite-hunt/file-assembler/file-header-processing), the LRIT File Header actually contains several header types with different sizes.

The headers can be divided into two groups:

- Primary Header
- Secondary Headers
